copy.subject: Welcome to Cake-me 💛
copy.preheader: Artisanal cheesecakes made to turn your everyday moments into little celebrations.
copy.headline: Hi, friend! Welcome to Cake-me 💛
body_blocks: We're so happy you're here! At Cake-me we make artisanal cheesecakes, and we make them for the moments that deserve a little extra happiness.
Think golden-brown, creamy, made-to-share goodness. A regular Tuesday? A birthday? A "just because"? We say it all deserves a slice 🌟
Over the next few emails we'll help you pick the perfect celebration cake and show you around. Ready to peek inside?
claims: Cake-me cheesecakes are meant to turn everyday moments into memorable, shareable celebrations

copy.purpose: value: how to choose a celebration cake
copy.subject: Picking a celebration cake? Start here
copy.preheader: Three quick questions to help you find the cheesecake that fits your moment.
copy.headline: Let's find your celebration cake 🌟
body_blocks: Choosing a celebration cake should be fun, not stressful! Ask yourself three things and you're almost there.
1. Who's it for? Picture their face when the cake appears. 2. What's the moment? A big milestone or a small win, both count. 3. Who's sharing? A cheesecake tastes even better with friends around 💛
Got your answers? Now go see which cheesecake makes you say "that's the one!" We're right here cheering you on.
claims: Cake-me cheesecakes are made to be shared and celebrated together
